audience: Maintainers choosing the next useful publishing surface for public documentation
question: When should a documentation publisher prioritize readable HTML, JSON-LD, or alternate Markdown?
direct_answer: Our editorial judgment is to establish a useful canonical page, add truthful structured facts for a defined consumer, and test Markdown only for a demonstrated client need.
original_contribution: A task-based comparison with evidence boundaries and explicit editorial fit judgments; no original performance measurements.
useful_action: Choose one failed reader or client task, then test the publishing surface that addresses it.

sources.support: Technical requirements require indexing and snippet eligibility for supporting links; SEO best practices include important textual content; additional AI files are unnecessary. No inclusion guarantee.
Google supports JSON-LD, requires markup to represent relevant visible content, and does not guarantee rich results even when markup is valid.
Observed page introduction advertises alternate Markdown documentation URLs by appending .md. Supports the existence of this first-party publishing pattern only.

claims.text: Google recommends important textual content and ordinary search eligibility for its AI features.
Google supports JSON-LD and requires its facts to represent relevant visible content.
OpenAI documentation advertises alternate Markdown URLs by appending .md to documentation page URLs.

comparison.methodology: Desk review of cited primary documentation checked on 2026-09-08. The use-it-when recommendations are ARWP editorial judgments. No speed, retrieval, ranking, price, or vendor performance trial was conducted. This comparison concerns complementary publishing approaches, not commercial product quality.

products.name: Canonical page with accessible text
products.best_for: A primary answer people can read, navigate, and cite; editorial judgment.
products.limitation: Useful HTML and technical eligibility do not guarantee indexing or selection.

products.name: JSON-LD beside visible content
products.best_for: A defined consumer of truthful entity relationships or applicable structured facts; editorial judgment.
products.limitation: Valid syntax cannot prove truth and valid markup does not guarantee a rich result.

products.name: Maintained alternate Markdown
products.best_for: A supported client with a demonstrated parsing benefit and a passing content-parity check; experimental fit judgment.
products.limitation: An observed publisher pattern is not an industry requirement or evidence of ranking impact.

publication_status: educational example only; example.com identity, noindex HTML; no external performance trial
